## 3. Core Clinical Diagnostic Triad
Every patient at Richfeel Vadodara undergoes non-invasive microscopic diagnostic mapping before any therapy:
1. Trichogram Analysis: Measures Anagen to Telogen (A/T) ratio to differentiate normal physiological shed from progressive androgenetic miniaturization.
2. Digital Capilloscopy: 200x high-magnification videodermoscopy examining scalp sebum quality, micro-vascular capillary circulation, and fungal ostia health.
3. Follicular Count Test: Quantifies follicular units and hairs per square centimeter to monitor male and female pattern hair thinning (MPT/FPT).

## 4. Patented Treatments & International Technologies
- TST+ (Tricho Scalp Therapy Plus): Austrian Manual Lymphatic Drainage (MLD) technique to detoxify lymphatic channels and halt active shedding.
- Richfeel Anagrow: Stem cell therapy utilizing PhytoCellTec Swiss Apple Stem Cells (Uttwiler Spätlauber) and Moroccan Argan delivered via the RF Anagain 10X transdermal machine (developed with Dr. Fred Zulli, Switzerland & Dr. Ferrari, Italy).
- Aesthetic Hair Transplant: Scar-free surgical follicular implantation developed with Ailesbury Hair Clinic, UK. Performed under local anesthesia with zero cuts, stitches, or linear scars.
- Non-Surgical Hair System: Breathable Swiss Lace second-skin permeable derma base for advanced baldness.
- Advanced PRP (Biotin Enriched): Autologous platelet-rich plasma fortified with medical-grade Biotin for keratin synthesis.
- Advanced Exosome GFC (Growth Factor Concentrate): A cellular, pure growth factor extraction that extends the anagen growth cycle.
- Richfeel Ana-d-tox: Power THP formula from USA containing Quinoa, Barley, and Wheat proteins to reverse and protect from hair color/chemical dye damage. Increases color retention by 20%.
- Laser Hair Reduction 2.0 (ICE CUBE): Large spot size continuous gliding with integrated Cool Brush contact chilling for virtually painless 90% permanent hair reduction.
- Advance Hydra Facial: Vortex suction exfoliation, vacuum extraction, and antioxidant super-serum infusion.
- Medi-Facial: Doctor-formulated facials with Richfeel Naturals active botanicals.
- Clinical Chemical Peels: Physician AHA/BHA peels for acne, melasma, enlarged pores, and hyperpigmentation.
- Anti-Dandruff Ultrasound Therapy: Ultrasonic delivery of keratostatic formulations for stubborn seborrheic dermatitis.
- Hair Hydratherapy: 5-step flax seed and wheat natural protein hydration (Hydro Rejuve & Hydro Revive).
- Photo Bio Therapy: UK cold laser beam Low-Level Light Therapy (LLLT).
